# prime-avatargroup

prime-rs: AvatarGroup component (port of PrimeNG)

[API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-avatargroup) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/avatargroup.md)

AvatarGroup — port of `p-avatar-group` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A container for several Avatars: root `div.p-avatar-group.p-component` (instead of the host `<p-avatar-group>`) with child content
without wrappers. The placement and overlap of the avatars are set by the theme CSS.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_avatargroup::AvatarGroup;

let html = view! { <AvatarGroup style_class="mine"><span>"a"</span><span>"b"</span></AvatarGroup> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-avatar-group p-component mine") && html.contains("a</span>"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-avatargroup = "0.1"
```

For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
